findings.highlight: Are you saying I should conveniently give you whatever you ask with nothing in return?
findings.evidenceJa: 空手でわたしと取り引きしよう、なんて都合のいいコト言うの？
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Shirou means to bargain with her empty-handed, continuing her claim that he brings no capital to the deal.
findings.explanation: The English invents Rin giving him whatever he asks and reverses a metaphor about his lack of bargaining resources into her unreciprocated generosity.

findings.governingReading: Shirou gives qualified, slightly evasive assent: he will somehow do what he can.
findings.explanation: “Try my best” sounds wholehearted and maximal, removing the comic bureaucratic hedge after Rin demands readiness for death.
